headline: Oil Hits Six-Month High Following Tanker Attack in Strait of Hormuz
summary: Crude oil prices settled at their highest level since April after a tanker was hit in the Strait of Hormuz, heightening market fears over regional energy supply disruptions.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical maritime chokepoint for crude oil transport.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Crude prices surged on heightened fears of supply chokepoint disruptions following the attack.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
